data.name: Rob
data.gender_notes: Rob is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Rob is derived from the Latin name Robert, which means 'bright fame'. It was popular among the early Christians and was given to boys born in the midst of fame or prosperity. The name Rob carries the meaning “Bright fame” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rob usually hope their child will grow to embody bright fame and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May your name be honored and your deeds shine bright.
data.etymology: Rob belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright fame.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rob total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: רוב
in_hebrew.meaning: משמעות של שם: בעל נטיות חיוביות, חזק, נאמן, ואוהב
in_hebrew.long_meaning: לשם רוב יש משמעות היסטורית ותרבותית חשובה במסורת הנוצרית. השם נבחר על ידי הורים נוצרים לבנם, כדי לרמז על תכונותיו החיוביות. השם רוב נחשב לשם נאמן וחזק, ובדומה להיסטוריה המקראית, השם רוב מסמל חוזק, אמונה, וכללי קדמוניות. הזיקה בין השם לבין תכונותיו האישיותיות, היא זיקה שאליה החברה הנוצרית חוגגת.

in_greek.name: Ρώβ
in_greek.meaning: σημασία του ονόματος: με την ενδυνάμωση, την αισχροκέρδειαν, την ευσυνειδησία, και την αγαπη
in_greek.long_meaning: το όνομα Ρώβ έχει ιστορική και πολιτισμική σημασία στην χριστιανική παράδοση. Επιλέγεται από γονείς χριστιανούς για τα παιδιά τους, να υποδηλώσει τις θετικές ιδιότητες τους. Το όνομα Ρώβ θεωρείται ως όνομα αληθές και ισχυρό, και, ως παρόμοιο με την ιστορία του βιβλίου, το όνομα Ρώβ συμβολίζει την ενδυνάμωση, την ευσυνειδησία, και τις αρχαίες κλάσεις. Η σύνδεση μεταξύ του ονόματος και των προσωπικών ιδιοκτητητή, είναι σύνδεση που η χριστιανική κοινωνία γιορτάζει.

in_latin.name: Rob
in_latin.meaning: significatio nominis: robustus, fidus, fortis, et amator
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen Rob habet significatio historica et culturalis in traditione christiana. Electus est a parentibus christianis filiis eorum, ut significet proprietates positivas. Nomen Rob est consideratum nomine fidelis et fortis, et, quod simile est cum historia biblica, nomen Rob significat robustia, fidelitas, et classes antiquae. Nexus inter nomen et proprietates individui, est nexus quem societas christiana celebrat.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rob has been commonly used in the English-speaking world, particularly in the United States and Canada, since the Middle Ages. Its popularity is due in part to the historical figures and saints named Robert, such as Robert the Bruce, Robert E. Lee, and St. Robert of Newminster. The name evokes a sense of strength, reliability, and prosperity.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Rob is associated with the virtues of faith, hope, and charity. It is a reminder that no matter how bright our fame or prosperity may be in this world, our true worth lies in our relationship with God. The name Rob can be seen as a call to strive for a bright and enduring fame in heaven, as opposed to fleeting fame in this world. It is a name that can inspire us to live lives that reflect the love and generosity of God.
